3092-the-conquest-of-new-france-a-chroni.title: The Conquest Of New France A Chronicle Of The Colonial Wars
3092-the-conquest-of-new-france-a-chroni.creator: George M. Wrong
3092-the-conquest-of-new-france-a-chroni.description: A book by George M. Wrong. Six years had barely passed when the English Captain Argall sailed to the north from Virginia and destroyed the rising French settlements. Sixteen years after this another English force attacked and captured Quebec. Presently these conquests were restored. France remained in possession of the St. Lawrence and in virtual possession of Acadia. The English colonies, holding a great stretch of the Atlantic seaboard, increased in number and power.

arxiv-1803-01614.title: Local energy transfer rate and kinetic processes: the fate of turbulent energy in two-dimensional Hybrid Vlasov-Maxwell numerical simulations
arxiv-1803-01614.creator: Luca Sorriso-Valvo 1, Denise Perrone 2,3, Oreste Pezzi 4, Francesco Valentini 4, Sergio Servidio 4, Ioannis Zouganelis 2 & Pierluigi Veltri 4
arxiv-1803-01614.description: Abstract The nature of the cross-scale connections between the inertial range turbulent energy cascade and the small-scale kinetic processes in collisionless plasmas is explored through the analysis of two-dimensional Hybrid Vlasov-Maxwell numerical simulation (HVM), with α \alpha particles, and through a proxy of the turbulent energy transfer rate, namely the Local Energy Transfer rate (LET).

arxiv-2111-14925.title: Reconstructing AGN X-ray spectral parameter distributions with Bayesian methods. I: Spectral analysis
arxiv-2111-14925.creator: Lingsong Ge (葛泠松), Stéphane Paltani, Dominique Eckert
arxiv-2111-14925.description: Abstract X-ray spectra of active galactic nuclei (AGN) consist of several different emission and absorption components. To determine the spectral parameters, these components are often fitted manually with models chosen on a case-by-case basis. However, this approach has two problems. First, it becomes very hard for a survey with a large number of sources.

arxiv-2203-11630.title: Decade-long time-monitoring of candidate Luminous Blue Variable Stars in the two very metal-deficient compact dwarf galaxies DDO 68 and PHL 293B Decade-long time-monitoring of candidate Luminous Blue Variable Stars in the two very metal-deficient compact dwarf galaxies DDO 68 and PHL 293B – Referenc
arxiv-2203-11630.creator: N. G. Guseva, T. X. Thuan, Y. I. Izotov
arxiv-2203-11630.description: Abstract We have studied the spectral time variations of candidate luminous blue variable stars (cLBV) in two low-metallicity blue compact dwarf galaxies, DDO 68 and PHL 293B. The LBV in DDO 68, located in H ii region #3, shows an outburst, with an increase of more than 1000 times in H α \alpha luminosity during the period 2008–2010.

arxiv-2302-11270.title: Perturbations of non-autonomous second-order abstract Cauchy problems Thanks: Declarations of interest: none.
arxiv-2302-11270.creator: Christian Budde, Christian Seifert
arxiv-2302-11270.description: Abstract . In this paper we present time-dependent perturbations of second-order non-autonomous abstract Cauchy problems associated to a family of operators with constant domain. We make use of the equivalence to a first-order non-autonomous abstract Cauchy problem in a product space, which we elaborate in full detail. As an application we provide a perturbed non-autonomous wave equation.

arxiv-2405-11942.creator: Dawid Wiśniewski, Zofia Rostek, Artur Nowakowski

arxiv-2407-18349.description: Abstract Understanding the impact of baryonic physics on cosmic structure formation is crucial for accurate cosmological predictions, especially as we usher in the era of large galaxy surveys with the Rubin Observatory as well as the Euclid and Roman Space Telescopes.

arxiv-2512-11406.title: Network Estimation for Stationary Time Series
arxiv-2512-11406.creator: Madeline A. Shelley, Chiara Boetti, Marina I. Knight, Matthew A. Nunes
arxiv-2512-11406.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Madeline A. Shelley, Chiara Boetti, Marina I. Knight, Matthew A. Nunes. High-dimensional multivariate time series are common in many scientific and industrial applications, where the interest lies in identifying key dependence structure within the data for subsequent analysis tasks, such as forecasting. An important avenue to achieve this is through the estimation of the conditional independence graph via graphical models, although for time series data settings the underpinning temporal dependence can make this task challenging.

britannica-1911-wavre.title: Wavre (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-wavre.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-wavre.description: Article 'Wavre' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. It was on this place that Grouchy advanced on the day of Waterloo, gaining a useless success here over a Prussian corps while the fate of the campaign was being decided elsewhere. The Prussians erected here a fine monument by Van Oemberg in 1859.

pmc-11389234.title: TMEM100 acts as a TAK1 receptor that prevents pathological cardiac hypertrophy progression
pmc-11389234.creator: Bin-Bin Zhang, Yi-Lin Zhao, Yan-Yu Lu, Ji-Hong Shen, Hui-Yong Li, Han-Xue Zhang, Xiao-Yue Yu, Wen-Cai Zhang, Gang Li, Zhan-Ying Han, Sen Guo, Xu-Tao Zhang
pmc-11389234.description: Pathological cardiac hypertrophy is the primary cause of heart failure, yet its underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Transmembrane protein 100 (TMEM100) plays a role in various disorders, such as nervous system disease, pain and tumorigenesis, but its function in pathological cardiac hypertrophy is still unknown. In this study, we observed that TMEM100 is upregulated in cardiac hypertrophy.

pmc-11466654.title: Reduced-distortion diffusion weighted imaging for head and neck radiotherapy
pmc-11466654.creator: Eric Aliotta, Ramesh Paudyal, Alex Dresner, Amita Shukla-Dave, Nancy Lee, Laura Cerviño, Ricardo Otazo, Victoria Y. Yu
pmc-11466654.description: Background and purposeQuantitative Diffusion Weighted Imaging (DWI) has potential value in guiding head and neck (HN) cancer radiotherapy. However, clinical translation has been hindered by severe distortions in standard single-shot Echo-Planar-Imaging (ssEPI) and prolonged scan time and low SNR in Turbo-Spin-Echo (ssTSE) sequences. In this study, we evaluate “multi-shot” (ms) msEPI and msTSE acquisitions in the context of HN radiotherapy.

pmc-11527283.title: Application and renovation evaluation of Dalian’s industrial architectural heritage based on AHP and AIGC
pmc-11527283.creator: Yao Liu, Pengjun Wu, Xiaowen Li, Wei Mo, Saeid Norouzian-Maleki, Saeid Norouzian-Maleki, Saeid Norouzian-Maleki, Saeid Norouzian-Maleki, Saeid Norouzian-Maleki
pmc-11527283.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This paper takes the example of industrial architectural heritage in Dalian to explore design scheme generation methods based on generative artificial intelligence (AIGC). The study compares the design effects of three different tools using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). It first establishes the key indicator weights for the renovation of industrial architectural heritage, with the criterion layer weights as follows: building renovation 0.230, environmental landscape 0.223, economic benefits 0.190, and socio-cultural value 0.356.

pmc-11618486.title: Models incorporating physical, laboratory and gut metabolite markers can be used to predict severe hepatic steatosis in MAFLD patients
pmc-11618486.creator: Yi‐Hsuan Lin, Ching‐Hsiang Wang, Yen‐Hsun Huang, Hsiao‐Chin Shen, Wei‐Kai Wu, Hsiao‐Yun Yeh, Chia‐Chang Huang, Chien‐Wei Su, Ying‐Ying Yang, Ming‐Shiang Wu, Han‐Chieh Lin, Ming‐Chih Hou
pmc-11618486.description: Metabolic‐associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) induced‐severe hepatic steatosis poses significant health risks. Early prediction of this condition is crucial for prompt intervention. Short‐chain fatty acids (SCFAs) and tryptophan are gut metabolites correlated with MAFLD pathogenesis in the gut–liver axis. This study aims to construct prediction models for severe hepatic steatosis by including SCFAs and tryptophan metabolites.

pmc-11798799.title: Splicing and expression dynamics of SR genes in hot pepper (Capsicum annuum): regulatory diversity and conservation under stress
pmc-11798799.creator: Lin Li, Yueqin Zhang, Rui Zhang, Xiangtao Cen, Yongxiang Huang, Hanqiao Hu, Xingyu Jiang, Yu Ling
pmc-11798799.description: In this study, we identified and characterized 23 genes encoding serine/arginine-rich (SR) protein in hot pepper (Capsicum annuum), named CaSR here. These CaSR proteins are grouped into seven subfamilies. Phylogenetic analysis revealed a high degree of similarity between CaSRs and their homologous proteins in other plants.

pmc-12533238.title: Impact of neoadjuvant and adjuvant chemotherapy on breast cancer prognosis in a propensity score matched population
pmc-12533238.creator: Ying Xu, Bowen Liu, Chang Chen, Feng Mao, Songjie Shen, Xiaohui Zhang, Xin Huang, Yan Lin, Yidong Zhou, Qiang Sun
pmc-12533238.description: Breast cancer is the most common cancer among women worldwide. To evaluate the real-world effectiveness of Neo-adjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) and adjuvant chemotherapy (ACT), we conducted a retrospective study comparing their impact on breast cancer prognosis. We retrieved data from the SEER database. We applied propensity score matching (PSM) to minimize confounding factors.

pmc-12559278.title: Investigating the expression changes of several key genes in prostate cancer cells under exposure to the ELF pulsed electromagnetic fields
pmc-12559278.creator: Abouzar Bahari, Javad Baharara, Khadijeh Nejad Shahrokhabadi, Maryam Lotfi
pmc-12559278.description: One of the less invasive methods in cancer treatment is the use of Extremely Low-Frequency Pulsed-Electromagnetic Fields (ELF P-EMF). In this study, after culturing and proliferating DU-145 prostate cancer cells, they were exposed to ELF P-EMF with different intensities and times.

pmc-12647096.title: Clinical characteristics of nephrocalcinosis in a tertiary children's hospital
pmc-12647096.creator: Jiajia Zheng, Jie Cao, Lan Chen, Xuhua Xia
pmc-12647096.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundNephrocalcinosis (NC) is often associated with prematurity, genetic, and/or metabolic disorders. However, studies focusing on NC in pediatric population remain limited.AimsThis study aimed to explore the etiology of NC and characterize clinical manifestation in children.MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed the electronic medical records of consecutive 50 children diagnosed with NC between January 1, 2016, and December 31, 2022, at the Children's Hospital of Chongqing Medical University.

pmc-13068720.title: Barriers and facilitators for implementing patient-reported outcome measures in oncology practices: an umbrella review
pmc-13068720.creator: Elke Rammant, Imogen Ramsey, Kelly M de Ligt, Carolyn Mazariego, Katarzyna Pogoda, Heike Schmidt, Kim Beernaert, Emma Lidington, Raymond Chan Javan, Bogda Koczwara, Monika Sztankay, Lonneke van de Poll-Franse, Mieke Van Hemelrijck
pmc-13068720.description: BackgroundPatient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) are increasingly valued for enhancing patient-centered care and clinical decision-making in oncology. However, routine use remains limited due to implementation challenges. This umbrella review synthesized evidence on barriers and facilitators to PROMs implementation in oncology care using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR).

pmc-13093818.title: Liquid biopsy biomarkers for early detection of gastrointestinal cancers: Current landscape and emerging technologies
pmc-13093818.creator: Muhammad Anees, Christopher Sherry, Hyun Y. Park, Erin E. Grayhack, Arul Goel, Alisha F. Khan, Ashten Omstead, David L. Bartlett, Ajay Goel, Neda Dadgar, Patrick L. Wagner, Ali H. Zaidi
pmc-13093818.description: Early detection of gastrointestinal (GI) cancers remains a critical unmet clinical need, as most patients are diagnosed at advanced stages when prognosis is poor. Liquid biopsy has emerged as a transformative approach for minimally invasive cancer detection by analysing tumour‐derived analytes in blood and other body fluids.

pmc-13233964.title: Reduced catalytic activity of KPC β-lactamase can increase ceftazidime resistance
pmc-13233964.creator: André Birgy, Dignite Fabrice Ngango, Murugesan Palaniappan, Shahlo O Solieva, Devin G Kelly, Zhizeng Sun, Gregory Bowman, Timothy Palzkill
pmc-13233964.description: β-Lactamases confer bacterial resistance by hydrolyzing β-lactam antibiotics. Klebsiella pneumoniae carbapenemases (KPCs) are a major cause of resistance to carbapenems, but combinations of β-lactams with β-lactamase inhibitors, such as ceftazidime/avibactam, initially restored activity against these enzymes. However, treatment has driven the emergence of KPC variants that evade inhibition.

pmc-13278969.title: Elevated serum levels of interleukin-11 and matrix metalloproteinase-9 in myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome
pmc-13278969.creator: Baskaran Chinnappan, Duraisamy Kempuraj, Kristina K. Aenlle, Ashley Middleton, Katie S. Day, Sai Puneeth Kothuru, Rhitik Samir Joshi, Nancy G. Klimas, Theoharis C. Theoharides
pmc-13278969.description: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) is a disease of unknown etiology associated with chronic severe fatigue and neurological symptoms, including dizziness, sleep disturbances, cognitive impairment and pain. There are no reliable blood biomarkers available for ME/CFS, possibly due to the lack of specific pathogenesis, even though Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV) has been suspected.

pmc-13315934.title: mTOR inhibition enhances the antitumor efficacy of pan-RAF-MEK blockade by inhibiting the ATF4-MTHFD2 pathway
pmc-13315934.creator: Feiyang Cai, Fan Huang, Christophe Goncalves, Harinee Srikannan, Natascha Gagnon, Elizabeth M. Guettler, Léa Mukeba-Harchies, Jennifer Maxwell, Jie Su, Krikor Bijian, Fabrice Journe, April A. N. Rose, Alexandre Orthwein, Sonia Victoria del Rincón, Wilson H. Miller
pmc-13315934.description: BRAF V600 inhibitors are clinically approved for the treatment of BRAFV600-mutant melanoma in combination with a MEK inhibitor, but are ineffective in other melanoma subtypes. Moreover, pan-RAF inhibitors, such as belvarafenib, when combined with MEK inhibitors (cobimetinib), have promising but limited efficacy in non-BRAF-mutant melanomas.

pmc-13342211.title: The Socioeconomic Effect of COVID-19 Pandemic on Iranian Children: The Mediating Role of Parents’ Mental Health
pmc-13342211.creator: Majid Golzarpour, Homeira Sajjadi, Paula Santana, Gholamreza Ghaedamini Harouni, Claudia Costa, Arash Ziapour, Seyed Amar Azizi, Sima Afrashteh
pmc-13342211.description: Background: COVID-19 has been troublesome for families due to its socio-economic changes worldwide. Therefore, the present study aimed to investigate the socio-economic burden of COVID-19 on children’s health in Iran.Methods: In the present cross-sectional study, the target population was 500 parents of children aged 5 to 18 years from 5 provinces of Iran in 2021.

pmc-13421792.title: Investigating the Association Between Anemia and Biochemical Factors in Relation to New Anthropometric Metrics in an Iranian Cohort: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13421792.creator: Maryam Kohsari, Zohreh Rahimi, Mehdi Moradinazar
pmc-13421792.description: Background and AimsObesity has become one of the most significant health issues worldwide, and the relationship between obesity and anemia remains controversial. This study aims to assess the relationship between lipid‐based obesity parameters, new anthropometric indices, and anemia in the Kurdish population of Iran.Methods9810 participants (48.2% male and 51.8% female) were evaluated in the present study.
